# Names machines read

The setting `RUNNER_SPEED` and the command `signal --low` keep their names.
Read the [route notes](runner-notes.md) first.
The map lives at maps/runner/hills.txt and its copy at https://example.com/signal/map.
The ledger runner.md lists each parcel.

```
runner signal parcel carrier
```

~~~
low water drift
~~~

The flag ``signal`` and the span `` a `b` runner `` keep their names.

The paths /runner/a, ./runner/b, ../runner/c, ~/runner, runner/, plugins/*/runner and **/signal stay.
So do maps/runner/signal.txt, [runner/signal.md], *~/signal* and (signal/runner.json).
